about: DMRG (tests/xcheck_impurity_tenpy.py, TeNPy 1.1.1, chi 400) of the three-band impurity models built in TeNPy from the VarBench parameters, against VarBench forkTPS rows (lowest variational row). Recorded runs, not rerun by the suite. TB-DMFT_9 agrees (7.7e-9 relative, DMRG above). TB-DMFT-SOC_9 does not: both hybridisation conventions (plain: V d+ c, conj: V* d+ c) give energies below VarBench, so the spin-orbit models are refused.
